CAPABILITIES

Our Production Capabilities

From raw material to packaged product: we bring non-woven felt and cleaning cloth production, lamination, cutting, converting and packaging together in our own production.

  • Non-woven felt
  • Non-woven cleaning cloth
  • Lamination
  • Cutting and shaping
  • Converting
  • Packaging

Production capabilities

01 /NON-WOVEN FELT

Non-Woven Felt Production

We produce the non-woven scouring felt that forms the scouring surface of dish sponges and scouring pads in our own facility.

The felts are produced in the 250–1000 g/m² range in nearly twenty colours and supplied as rolls, sheets or cut shapes in the standard 1.02 m width, a wide 2 m width or narrow widths of 40–68 cm. Besides being used in our own products, they are also supplied to manufacturers developing other products.

  • 250–1000 g/m²
  • Nearly twenty colours
  • 1.02 m standard roll width
  • Rolls, sheets and cut shapes

RELATED PRODUCTS

  • Scouring felt in rolls↗
  • Scouring felt sheet↗
  • Scouring materials↗
01

02 /NON-WOVEN CLEANING CLOTH

Non-Woven Cleaning Cloth Production

We produce the non-woven cloth used in cleaning cloths, floor cloths and mop cloths in rolls in our own facility.

The cloths are made in the 80–320 g/m² range with viscose–polyester ratios from 20% to 80%; options include plain-coloured, printed (floral, droplet and tartan patterns), embossed and 30% microfibre. Rolls are slit to different widths from 27 cm to 210 cm as required.

  • 80–320 g/m²
  • 20–80% viscose content
  • Plain, printed and microfibre
  • 27–210 cm roll width

RELATED PRODUCTS

  • Non-woven cleaning cloth in rolls↗
  • Printed cleaning cloth in rolls↗
  • Cleaning cloths↗
02

03 /LAMINATION

Lamination

We laminate scouring felt to a sponge body to make felt-laminated sponge sheets, the basis of dish sponges.

Besides being used in our own products, the sheets can also be supplied as sheet raw material to be cut to the required size. Felt colour, sponge colour and thickness are assessed together according to need.

  • Sponge + scouring felt
  • Sheet form
  • Suitable for cutting to size

RELATED PRODUCTS

  • Felt-laminated sponge sheet↗
  • Cleaning sponges↗
03

04 /CUTTING AND SHAPING

Cutting and Shaping

We cut and shape sponges in different forms according to their intended use, such as flat, grooved (with a grip profile), oval and butterfly.

Our range extends from a 7.5 cm make-up removal sponge to a 90 cm door threshold sponge; size and shape can be determined together as required.

  • Flat and grooved forms
  • Oval and butterfly shapes
  • Product sizes from 7.5 to 90 cm

RELATED PRODUCTS

  • Grooved dish sponge↗
  • Oval massage bath sponge↗
  • Oval car sponge↗
04

05 /CONVERTING

Converting

We convert foam and roll raw materials into the required sizes and shapes: foam blocks are sliced, and roll cloths are made into perforated rolls, folded cloths and cut sheets.

Size, shape and cut are determined together according to the product being made.

  • Sponge slicing
  • Perforated rolls and folded cloths
  • Cut sheets

RELATED PRODUCTS

  • Perforated cleaning cloth in rolls↗
  • Felt-laminated sponge sheet↗
05

06 /PACKAGING

Packaging

We prepare products in different packaging, from single packs to 12-piece hanging cards.

Depending on the product, goods are shipped in cases, plastic bags or sacks. Besides our own brands, we can also discuss private-label production requests with you.

  • Packs from single items to 12-piece cards
  • Cases, plastic bags, sacks
  • Private-label production

RELATED PRODUCTS

  • Private-label production↗
  • Cleaning sponges↗
